reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, and I would scan it before buying to check the report is a real batch report from a named ISO 17025 lab. The sachets would be handy in my carry-on, so I would try one box, and I would only reorder if the report holds up.
objection: It is a brand with zero reviews, and the lab testing is the brand's own claim, not NSF or USP certified. I would want to see the report is real, recent and matches the 200 mg on the box.
would_change_my_mind: NSF or USP certification, or a handful of verified reviews. If the QR report did not load or looked generic, I would not buy.
